BiblicalUsage: Jishma is an Israelite, a son of Etam of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:3, Ishma, and Idbash.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ishma is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
